integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; the proof is included via Rosenlicht stratification.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0007036 is dated 2000-07-06.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: The diagonal action has precisely the monomial pairs as fixed points, and their gcd degree is computed directly from the two exponent pairs.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The journal record lists MSC 14N99 first, followed by 13P99 and 13D25.
integrity.resultant_basis: The cited source states that the homogeneous resultant vanishes on systems with a common projective root, identifies the Sylvester matrix as the binary-form determinantal formula, and discusses homogeneous subresultants.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns pairs of binary forms, not multivariate common-factor loci.
Exact gcd-degree strata use compactly supported Euler characteristic.
Euler characteristic is coarse and does not determine finer topology or singularity structure.
The localization proof is short, so an older unindexed observation may contain the same formulas.
title: Euler characteristics of the binary common-factor filtration
